name: TC-PTB-02: all popular brand cards show name, logo, title and brand URL
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/PopularTruckBrands.cy.js#Homepage - PopularTruckBrands [ta] TC-PTB-02: all popular brand cards show name, logo, title and brand URL
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-PTB-02
**Title:** All popular brand cards show name, logo, title and brand URL
**Language:** ta

**Description:**
In the Popular Truck Brands section, verify every expected brand card displays the brand name, logo image, accessible title, and link to that brand’s page.

**Expected Result:**
Each brand from test data appears once with the correct visible name, logo, title attribute, and href pointing to the brand page for that language.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Popular Truck Brands section
2. For each expected brand, verify name, logo, title and URL
3. Confirm the total number of brand cards matches test data
